caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object labeled "Mirror Rack" centered on a plain, off-white or beige background. The rack consists of a vertical slab of wood with a rounded top and a horizontal base attached near the bottom, forming a T-shape. The vertical slab is medium brown in color, and there is a brass or gold-colored metal hook near its rounded top, along with two small circular metallic fasteners aligned vertically below the hook. The horizontal base is also wooden and has two visible metallic fasteners, one near each end. The object's shading is consistent, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. There are handwritten words “Mirror Rack” beneath the rack in grayish pencil or ink, and a signature is located in the lower right corner of the image. The background has no additional objects or decorations.
title: Shaker Mirror Rack
